removedConditionalRequirements.name: Advantage: Experience
removedConditionalRequirements.description:
Play only if you have no Knowledge limit. Draw a page.

When in control, the first move you do each turn does +1 damage.

removedConditionalRequirements.name: Advantage: Power
removedConditionalRequirements.description:
When in control, the first Strength move you do each turn does +1 damage.

If you have 4 Strength and 4 Strike, you do +4 damage instead.

removedConditionalRequirements.name: Advantage: Precision
removedConditionalRequirements.description: Choose a body part. Whenever you connect with a Strike move it does +1 damage to that part. If there is 7 or more damage on that part, you draw a random Standing Above move from your playbook.

removedConditionalRequirements.name: Advantage: Impact
removedConditionalRequirements.description:
Whenever you connect with an Impact move your opponent loses an extra Attitude.

If you have 4 Strike and 4 Agility, the move does +3 damage and you also gain +1 Attitude.

removedConditionalRequirements.name: Ahead of The Game
removedConditionalRequirements.description:
Draw a page.

At the beginning of each turn, you are told how many pages are remaining in your and your opponent's playbooks. This page is removed from play when you are Stunned. You can only have one Ahead of The Game in play. If you ditch this page it counts as 2 pages.

removedConditionalRequirements.name: Always Thinking
removedConditionalRequirements.description:
Draw a page.
After you draw a page during the Refresh step, you are told what the next page is. This effect lasts until you are Stunned. Multiple uses of this page allow you to see more pages from your playbook.

removedConditionalRequirements.name: Back-Up Plan
removedConditionalRequirements.description:
Play once per match. When played, all pages in your hand are "moved inside" Back-Up Plan and you draw five pages.

Special: All of the pages in your hand are ditched and the pages "inside" Back-Up Plan are moved to your hand. Back-Up Plan is removed from the game.
